knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The table lists the underside of the frame weekly in the three highest levels. Daily applies to the frame itself, and the other options do not match the table.
The table calls for a change when the patient leaves if they carried a multi-resistant organism or another infection. Option B reflects that; the others misreport the table.
IV stands and drip stands have contact points cleaned after use at the higher levels. The other options do not sit in that after-use category.

practicalCriteria: Learner reads the bed clean line for the assigned area and states the discharge clean.
Learner cleans the contact points on one piece of equipment after use, as demonstrated.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: Equipment has a visible body substance and the learner lacks the protective equipment required
A mattress or cover is damaged and the learner cannot confirm the cleaning method
